concerns.text: FR-007 (document all random seeds in reproducible config) is tagged to T004b, but T004b is marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec requires this mechanism to exist for reproducibility (Constitution Principle I). No other task covers the implementation of the seed-injection logic in config.py.

FR-001 (generate global batch) and US-1 rely on T018 (batch_runner.py main() function). T018 is marked [ ] (incomplete). The plan explicitly requires this orchestrator to iterate topology classes. Without it, the global batch generation cannot be executed.

FR-003 (measure energy diffusion rate) and US-2 require the output artifact `data/analysis/simulation_results.json`. T029 (result serialization) is marked [ ] (incomplete). No other task explicitly implements the serialization of the diffusion rate metric to this file.

Plan Phase 2 requires strict schema validation for simulation results. T029a (define JSON schema) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without the schema definition, the data pipeline lacks the required validation contract for `runtime_duration_seconds` and `diffusion_rate`.

Spec Edge Cases (Simulation Divergence/Timeout) require a hard runtime abort mechanism. T026b (implement hard runtime abort) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec mandates this abort logic to handle numerical instability and time limits.

FR-008 (sensitivity analysis) requires sweeping clustering thresholds. T035b (implement sensitivity sweep) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec requires reporting diffusion rates at ≥5 distinct cutoffs, which this task is intended to implement.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires runnable scripts and audit trails. T005 (initialize logging infrastructure) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec requires `data/run_log.json` to be created and populated for run metrics.

Plan Phase 2 specifies dynamic batch-size adjustment based on rejection rates. T056 (Sample Size Adjustment logic) is marked [ ] (incomplete). This logic is required to meet the global volume targets (SC-001) if rejection rates are high.

Plan Phase 2 requires CPU-time profiling to validate SC-002 (runtime constraints). T070 (CPU-time profiling) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The plan explicitly states this task is needed to measure `time_per_spin_flip_iteration`.

FR-006 (multiple-comparison correction) requires comparing Bonferroni vs. BH methods. T071 (Bonferroni vs. BH comparison) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec requires logging both methods and selecting one based on config.

SC-005 (Threshold sensitivity) requires reporting diffusion rates at ≥5 distinct thresholds. T072 (threshold sweep visualization) is marked [ ] (incomplete). While T035b generates data, T072 is the specific task for the visual verification required by SC-005.

ROC-001 (Associational framing) requires a disclaimer in all figures/tables. T073 (associational framing check) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec mandates this specific text be appended to all generated outputs.

FR-001 (global batch) requires diversity of topology classes. T074 (graph diversity validator) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The spec requires ensuring at least 3 distinct topology classes and no single class exceeding a majority.
